description: Semifinal observable-anomaly taxonomy. Categories describe telemetry phenomena, not injected fault mechanisms or root causes.

types.definition: Service-level request latency is materially higher than a comparable baseline or surrounding window.
observable_evidence: request latency metric distribution
time-aligned request spans with a baseline comparison

types.definition: Service-level failed-request count or rate materially increases relative to a comparable baseline.
observable_evidence: request error counter converted to a rate
time-aligned failed request spans

types.definition: Explicit request timeout or deadline-exceeded observations materially increase.
observable_evidence: timeout metrics
explicit timeout logs
deadline-exceeded spans

types.definition: CPU usage or CPU consumption rate is materially elevated for the stated entity.
observable_evidence: CPU gauge
rate derived from a CPU counter
throttling ratio used only as supporting evidence

types.definition: Memory usage or working set is materially elevated for the stated entity.
observable_evidence: memory working-set gauge
memory usage gauge with a baseline comparison

types.definition: Observed Pod restart count or restart events increase during the submitted interval.
observable_evidence: restart counter converted to events or rate
time-aligned restart log or Kubernetes event

types.definition: Explicit error-severity or semantically equivalent error logs form a time-localized burst.
observable_evidence: multiple time-aligned error records
error-rate comparison against a baseline

types.definition: Service span or end-to-end trace latency materially increases in Trace telemetry.
observable_evidence: span or trace latency distribution with baseline and anomalous samples

types.definition: Latency on a directed source-to-target service call edge materially increases.
observable_evidence: parent-child span edge comparison with baseline and anomalous samples

types.definition: Failed calls on a directed source-to-target service edge materially increase.
observable_evidence: failed parent-child edge spans compared with a baseline

types.definition: A clearly observable and evidence-backed phenomenon not covered by another published category. It is never a substitute for an uncertain diagnosis and requires specific description and human review.
observable_evidence: specific quantitative or repeated-record evidence plus an explicit description of the observed deviation
